---
title: abcpp
description: "<code>abcpp</code> is a lightweight, embeddable C++ backend for offline Approximate Bayesian Computation workflows, inspired by CRAN's <code>abc</code> package and exposed through thin R and Python frontends. It currently focuses on matrix-based ABC estimation with <code>target</code>, <code>params</code>, <code>sumstats</code>, and <code>control</code>, while laying the groundwork for a future NLopt-like ABC algorithm library supporting both offline simulation-table ABC and online simulator-callback ABC for projects such as <code>metaSDT</code>."
